attribution.component: Finite measurement/fiber sum-product identity, specialized here to GF(2).

counting_note: Counts are executed local assignment visits and table-pair products; integer bit costs and validation are additional. No wall-clock claims.

identity_measurement_barrier.all_b_proof: The signature of u is I_b u = u, so all 2^b local assignments have different signatures and each table entry has multiplicity one.
identity_measurement_barrier.claim_scope: For this explicit table algorithm only, the b-bit identity map creates 2^b entries for every b; the all-zero target is easy globally.

scope: Exact finite GF(2) group-signature counting; not a P versus NP resolution.
